digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure - subprocess and network timeout oracles
propositions: Two reliability tests encode production-scale real-time values (10s low-speed window with 15s loopback server; 1s per-attempt deadline with real 2s/4s retry sleeps) causing 15–25s long poles despite contracting on throughput/retry schedule/process count rather than elapsed time.
Snapshot fetch stall test must retain real loopback socket and above-floor byte pacing for more than one complete injected window without being classified as a stall.

ACLI subprocess timeout test must launch exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real child processes, observe the exact production retry schedule [2, 4] without sleeping it, and prove every spawned PID is absent after terminal failure.
Injection of sub-second call/grace/drain values and polling-based cleanup must replace real retry sleeps and wall-clock pass thresholds while keeping production defaults and semantics byte-unchanged.
